# PASS-required tests with Linux-conformant semantics.
testcases/kernel/syscalls/close/close01.c verified close(2) for file/pipe/socket descriptors
testcases/kernel/syscalls/close/close02.c verified close(2) EBADF on invalid fd
testcases/kernel/syscalls/clone/clone08.c verified CLONE_PARENT, CLONE_CHILD_SETTID, CLONE_PARENT_SETTID, and CLONE_THREAD clear_child_tid/futex orchestration within the supported clone subset
testcases/kernel/syscalls/epoll_create1/epoll_create1_01.c verified epoll_create1 CLOEXEC behavior
testcases/kernel/syscalls/epoll_create1/epoll_create1_02.c verified epoll_create1 EINVAL on invalid flags
testcases/kernel/syscalls/epoll_wait/epoll_wait07.c verified EPOLLONESHOT readiness suppression with epoll_create1-backed LTP coverage
testcases/kernel/syscalls/exit/exit01.c verified exit(2) reports the expected wait status to the parent
testcases/kernel/syscalls/exit/exit02.c verified exit(2) closes inherited file descriptors so child writes are visible without an explicit close
testcases/kernel/syscalls/exit_group/exit_group01.c verified exit_group(2) terminates the entire thread group with the requested status
testcases/kernel/syscalls/eventfd2/eventfd2_01.c verified eventfd2(2) CLOEXEC flag propagation
testcases/kernel/syscalls/eventfd2/eventfd2_02.c verified eventfd2(2) O_NONBLOCK flag propagation
testcases/kernel/syscalls/eventfd2/eventfd2_03.c verified EFD_SEMAPHORE plain-fork wake/resume semantics with local guest fixtures and full LTP pass
testcases/kernel/syscalls/faccessat/faccessat01.c verified faccessat(2) relative/absolute/AT_FDCWD existence checks
testcases/kernel/syscalls/faccessat/faccessat02.c verified faccessat(2) ENOTDIR and EBADF error paths
testcases/kernel/syscalls/fstatat/fstatat01.c verified newfstatat basic path/dirfd errno handling
testcases/kernel/syscalls/ftruncate/ftruncate01.c verified ftruncate(2) shrink and extend semantics
testcases/kernel/syscalls/futex/futex_wake01.c verified futex(FUTEX_WAKE) returns 0 when no waiters are present
testcases/kernel/syscalls/futex/futex_cmp_requeue02.c verified futex(FUTEX_CMP_REQUEUE) returns Linux-shaped EINVAL/EAGAIN for invalid wake counts, requeue counts, and compare mismatches
testcases/kernel/syscalls/futex/futex_wait01.c verified futex(FUTEX_WAIT) returns ETIMEDOUT for timed waits and EWOULDBLOCK for value mismatches
testcases/kernel/syscalls/futex/futex_wait02.c verified futex(FUTEX_WAIT) blocks on a shared futex and resumes when a forked child issues FUTEX_WAKE
testcases/kernel/syscalls/futex/futex_wait03.c verified pthread-backed private FUTEX_WAIT wake/join fanout after suppressing duplicate plain-fork external wake accounting during deferred clone-thread service
testcases/kernel/syscalls/futex/futex_wait04.c verified anonymous zero-page FUTEX_WAIT mismatch returns Linux-shaped EWOULDBLOCK on freshly mmapped private pages
testcases/kernel/syscalls/futex/futex_wait05.c verified timed FUTEX_WAIT duration accounting once deferred plain-fork waits advance guest monotonic time instead of host wall time
testcases/kernel/syscalls/futex/futex_wait_bitset01.c verified FUTEX_WAIT_BITSET absolute-timeout semantics for both CLOCK_MONOTONIC and FUTEX_CLOCK_REALTIME
testcases/kernel/syscalls/futex/futex_wake02.c verified pthread-backed private FUTEX_WAKE fanout after restricting plain-fork futex bookkeeping to process leaders
testcases/kernel/syscalls/futex/futex_wake03.c verified shared-process FUTEX_WAKE fanout after restoring non-aliased plain-fork snapshots and leader-only futex bookkeeping
testcases/kernel/syscalls/getpgid/getpgid01.c verified getpgid(2) basic parent/child and init-process lookup semantics
testcases/kernel/syscalls/getpgid/getpgid02.c verified getpgid(2) returns ESRCH for nonexistent pids
testcases/kernel/syscalls/geteuid/geteuid01.c verified basic geteuid(2) success path
testcases/kernel/syscalls/getcpu/getcpu02.c verified getcpu(2) EFAULT handling for cpu_id/node_id pointers outside the process address space
testcases/kernel/syscalls/getuid/getuid01.c verified basic getuid(2) success path
testcases/kernel/syscalls/lseek/lseek01.c verified lseek(2) basic offset movement and reads
testcases/kernel/syscalls/mkdirat/mkdirat01.c verified mkdirat(2) relative/absolute dirfd handling
testcases/kernel/syscalls/openat/openat01.c verified openat(2) relative/absolute dirfd handling
testcases/kernel/syscalls/pread/pread01.c verified pread(2) reads at offsets without changing file position
testcases/kernel/syscalls/pwrite/pwrite01.c verified pwrite(2) writes at offsets without changing file position
testcases/kernel/syscalls/read/read01.c verified basic read(2) success path
testcases/kernel/syscalls/read/read04.c verified read(2) returns correct byte count and data
testcases/kernel/syscalls/sched_getaffinity/sched_getaffinity01.c verified single-CPU affinity mask and error handling
testcases/kernel/syscalls/sched_yield/sched_yield01.c verified sched_yield returns success
testcases/kernel/syscalls/setpgid/setpgid01.c verified setpgid(2) basic caller/child process-group updates
testcases/kernel/syscalls/setpgid/setpgid02.c verified setpgid(2) EINVAL, ESRCH, and EPERM error cases
testcases/kernel/syscalls/setpgid/setpgid03.c verified setpgid(2) rejects moving an execve()'d child while preserving the session-leader EPERM cases
testcases/kernel/syscalls/set_robust_list/set_robust_list01.c verified set_robust_list(2) accepts sizeof(robust_list_head) and rejects invalid len
testcases/kernel/syscalls/set_tid_address/set_tid_address01.c verified set_tid_address(2) returns the thread-group leader tid for the main thread
testcases/kernel/syscalls/setsid/setsid01.c verified setsid(2) rejects callers that are already process-group leaders after nested setpgid choreography
testcases/kernel/syscalls/sigaltstack/sigaltstack02.c verified sigaltstack(2) reports EINVAL for invalid flags and ENOMEM for undersized alternate stacks
testcases/kernel/syscalls/tgkill/tgkill03.c verified invalid/defunct tgkill errno surface and pthread-backed checkpoint fanout once deferred clone-thread ownership and plain-fork external futex wake accounting matched Linux-shaped behavior
testcases/kernel/syscalls/sysinfo/sysinfo01.c verified sysinfo(2) success path
testcases/kernel/syscalls/sysinfo/sysinfo02.c verified sysinfo(2) EFAULT on invalid address
testcases/kernel/syscalls/truncate/truncate02.c verified truncate(2) shrink/extend semantics without changing file offset
testcases/kernel/syscalls/uname/uname01.c verified uname(2) reports Linux sysname
testcases/kernel/syscalls/uname/uname02.c verified uname(2) EFAULT on invalid address
testcases/kernel/syscalls/unlinkat/unlinkat01.c verified unlinkat file/remove-dir errno handling
testcases/kernel/syscalls/vfork/vfork01.c verified vfork(2) preserves parent credentials, cwd, and umask while parent waits for child _exit
testcases/kernel/syscalls/vfork/vfork02.c verified vfork(2) children do not inherit the parent's pending signals
testcases/kernel/syscalls/wait4/wait401.c verified wait4(2) reaps a child and reports normal exit status
testcases/kernel/syscalls/wait4/wait402.c verified wait4(2) returns ECHILD for an invalid positive pid
testcases/kernel/syscalls/wait4/wait403.c verified wait4(2) returns ESRCH for pid == INT_MIN
testcases/kernel/syscalls/waitid/waitid06.c verified waitid(2) filters direct children by PID and reports minimal siginfo_t on normal exit
testcases/kernel/syscalls/waitid/waitid09.c verified waitid(2) returns ECHILD for non-child P_PID targets even when other children exist
testcases/kernel/syscalls/waitpid/waitpid04.c verified waitpid(2) ECHILD, EINVAL, and ESRCH error handling for no-child and invalid-input cases
testcases/kernel/syscalls/waitpid/waitpid09.c verified waitpid(2) WNOHANG semantics for running/exited children and ECHILD on no-children cases
testcases/kernel/syscalls/write/write02.c verified write(fd, NULL, 0) returns 0
testcases/kernel/syscalls/epoll_ctl/epoll_ctl01.c verified epoll_ctl(2) add/mod/del semantics on ready pipe fds
